blockersForTheIntegrator.title: the merged round-3 tree cannot build a Spanish course: 9,269 of 9,449 authored candidates are stale_ledger
blockersForTheIntegrator.notFiledBecause: docs/P2-BLOCKERS.md is not in this task's file lane
blockersForTheIntegrator.cause: a cross-lane collision neither lane is wrong about on its own. p2r3/lemma-reachability rewrote content/es/curriculum.yaml and does not only ADD forms: blocks - it removes target lexemes (gracias->gracia, media->medio, fuera->afuera, and ella, nosotros, ellos, llamarse, encontrarse and the ten reflexive verbs dropped outright), which moves every slot's known|new set and therefore every ledger_digest. p2r3/gapfill-lesson1 measured its green G5 and G6 on a tree WITHOUT that lane: `git merge-base --is-ancestor p2r3/lemma-reachability p2r3/gapfill-lesson1` is false and the two curriculum.yaml files differ. Founder ruling B9 named the remedy in advance - 'Re-key only rows whose ledger_digest changes' - and the re-key was not done.

twoDiagnosticBuildsThatBoundTheCost.withoutLemmaReachability: g5 failed: 8 slot(s) exhausted every candidate: u1/l1/s1 ... u1/l1/s8 - B9 recurring one lesson later, because the OLD unit-1 window cannot hold the greeting the gapfill lane authored

withLemmaReachabilityAfterAMechanicalDig.whyReStampingIsNotABypass: G5's out_of_vocabulary axis independently compares every lexical lemma to the slot's known|new set and rejected 188 rows in that run. The digest is the cheap fast-fail; the vocabulary check is the substantive one.

blockersForTheIntegrator.costOfAGreenBuild: re-key the 9,812-row bank against the merged ledger, drop the 363 surplus orphan rows, author 20 candidates for each of 22 empty slots (440 sentences), and expect ~87 slots to need a second authoring pass. Six of the 22 are u1/l3, whose window is 15 lemmas with NO VERB (yo, tu, usted, el plus greetings) - that one is a curriculum decision in the shape of B9, not authoring work.

fourthSymptomTheSuiteSees.what: `uv run pytest` on the merged tree is RED: 3 failures in tools/coursekit/tests/test_g5_gapfill.py
fourthSymptomTheSuiteSees.measured: the third one asserts the pinned lemmatiser's RAW behaviour - {'Buenos dias.': ['buenos', 'dia'], 'Buenas noches.': ['buenas', 'noches'], ...} - and on the merged tree the adapter now returns ['bueno', 'dia'] / ['bueno', 'noche'], because that is exactly what the lemma-reachability lane's B9(a) normalisation table is FOR. `uv run pytest -q tests/test_g5_gapfill.py` on p2r3/gapfill-lesson1 alone: 56 passed.
fourthSymptomTheSuiteSees.whyItMatters: pack-ci.yml's `coursekit lint + tests` job runs `uv run pytest` on every push, and `pipeline-ready` gates build-es/validate-es behind it. So this collision does not only stop the pack - it turns the fast job red at the integration, which is the right behaviour and the thing to fix first because it is the cheapest signal.
fourthSymptomTheSuiteSees.notCausedByThisLane: this task changed no Python and no content: `git status --porcelain` is three files, content/es/review/scores.jsonl, content/es/review/scores-method.md and docs/owned/p2r3-reviewer-sample.json.
fourthSymptomTheSuiteSees.whoOwnsTheFix: the two lanes together. Either the gapfill lane's three tests are re-based on the normalised adapter (they are assertions about the OLD adapter, and the normalisation is a founder ruling), or the normalisation is scoped so it does not reach that probe. test_g5_gapfill.py and adapters/spacy_es.py are both outside this lane.

blockersForTheIntegrator.title: a Latin-American variety word reached the peninsular authored bank, and no validator can see it
blockersForTheIntegrator.detail: Three rows of 300 use `cancha` where a peninsular course says `pista` or `campo` (rows 264, 266, 270, all u28 - scored awkward on `register`). This is the TEXT-side echo of accent_claim: unverified, and unlike the accent it IS falsifiable by a validator: a per-course variety word-list at G6 would catch it. No such check exists.

contentReviewSample.whatItIs: a 300-row stratified review of the content the sheet would be drawn from. NOT the H1 sheet: rows are keyed by candidate_id (authored) or sentence_id (corpus), never by exercise_id, because no exercise exists.

method.allocator: coursekit.sample.allocate() - the tool's own, so the draw is auditable
method.rng: random.Random(SAMPLE_SEED) over a population sorted by (unit, lesson, slot, id)
method.whatTheThirdStratumCannotBe: the real sheet stratifies over (unit_index, exercise_type, provenance). exercise_type cannot exist here, so nothing below measures word banks, distractors, cloze gaps, match grids or accepted-answer sets AS THE TOOL BUILDS THEM. `answer_set` was scored against the sentence pair only. A real sheet would also catch a valid answer sitting in the distractor list; this one cannot.

rates.theThreeRepeatedPatterns: six of the twelve wrong items are three reusable patterns, not six independent mistakes: the `Continua ...` / 'You carry on' gloss (rows 98, 100), the `hay {weather}` / 'There is clouds' gloss (rows 123, 124), and ser + limpio for a room (rows 150, 151). Fixing those three and redrawing would put the rate at 6/300 = 2.00% - AT the gate, not under it. 2% is reachable from here; 0% is not.
rates.howTheTwoProvenancesFailDifferently: near-equal wrong rates hide opposite failure modes. Both corpus defects are ENGLISH-side mis-glosses of natural Spanish; the authored bank is correctly glossed Spanish nobody would say (26.83% awkward against 3.70%). A course built from this bank would read as grammatical and empty.

reviewer.independence: NONE. Every provenance: llm row carries author 'claude-opus-5 (agent; Freelingo p2fix-author-... lane)' and this reviewer is a Claude Opus agent in the same workflow: the same model family marking its own homework. The paid native Spanish review stays a release prerequisite (docs/RELEASE.md item 1), and a 4% agent-measured rate is an argument for commissioning it sooner.
reviewer.knownBias: a reviewer from the author's own model family is least reliable where the content is most defensible-looking. 64 of the 68 awkward verdicts are grammatical, correctly glossed, semantically empty sentences - the exact shape this reviewer is most likely to wave through. Read 22.67% as a floor.

contentReviewSample.howToReKeyTheseVerdictsOntoARealSheet: when one green `coursekit build es` exists, run `uv run coursekit sample es` and join these rows onto the drawn sheet by `text` - the mapping is 1:1 through the exercise row's source_sentence_id. Do not carry a verdict onto an exercise whose text changed, and do not carry the corpus rows at all unless the corpus digest above matches.
